name: msm-historical-audit-engine
description: Multi-agent historical audit engine: Agentic Archive Retrieval, MoE debate on predictive accuracy, and ontological mapping of narrative shifts.

steps.name: agentic-archive-retrieval
steps.prompt_template: Query mainstream media archive {{input.archive_source}} for the narrative: {{input.target_narrative}}. Extract core predictions and their confidence levels.

steps.name: historical-outcome-alignment
steps.prompt_template: Align extracted predictions {{archive_extractions}} with verified current OSINT outcomes. Highlight stark deviations or successful forecasts.

steps.name: moe-debate-audit
steps.prompt_template: Perform multi-turn adversarial debate on the outcome alignment: {{outcome_alignment}}. Defend or critique the media's accountability based on the Prometheus 2 Rubric (Relevance, Correctness, Neutrality, Evidence). Output 'DEBATE_CONCLUDED' when consensus on accountability score is reached.

steps.name: ontological-narrative-mapping
steps.prompt_template: Map the consensus audit result {{audit_debate_result}} to the Disinformation Taxonomy Ontology. Output final structured accountability report.
